facts: Eclectic monument opened 1890, designed by Jean-Jacques Winders and Frans Van Dijk. The front combines Corinthian orders, stone reliefs and the Vinçotte chariots.
The 1890 museum became recognizable with Thomas Vinçotte’s 1905 chariot groups.
Rooflight elements in the restored museum face north and illuminate the distinct new interior volume.
Existing copper roofs were renewed; aged copper gradually becomes brown and green.
